notes.text: Available in cPanel 88 and later; operates on the selected account. No request defaults are declared in the pinned operation. Directory paths are sent unchanged and are not normalized by the client.

Returns leech protection information, separately from DirectoryPrivacy password protection. dir may be an absolute path or a path relative to the selected account home directory. children, current, home and parent contain optional path and state.has_leech_protection fields. The integer 1 enables leech protection and 0 disables it; this payload flag is distinct from UAPI success status. Omitted fields remain absent; an empty children list remains empty.
